aboutGame.title: What is Dig to Escape?
paragraphs: Dig to Escape is a prison-break survival game built on one promise: somewhere under the cell block, a secret tunnel leads out. You start locked in a cell with a digging tool, break through the floor, and follow the softest dirt downward while a guard patrols the corridors above. The loop is easy to learn and tense to run, because every swing of the shovel is a trade-off between progress and noise.

The game ships two ways: a free Roblox experience with shared public servers, and a $12.99 VR release from K&K Studio for Meta Quest headsets. Runs last roughly 30 to 60 minutes and finish in one of several distinct endings, including the Mineshaft, Kitchen, Janitor's and Rooftops finales. Our Dig to Escape wiki covers every route, tool tier and class so you can choose a plan before your first swing.

modules.name: Dig to Escape Beginner Guide
modules.description: Start here for the full beginner loop, from scouting your cell to timing the final break, plus the digging and selling habits that make early runs click.

highlights.detail: Scan the cell block and main corridor from inside your cell before you touch the floor.
Dig a shallow starter hole in a cell corner, where the walls muffle the noise.
Break through to the dig layer slowly and freeze whenever footsteps get close.
Follow the softest dirt, which usually marks the route toward the hidden tunnel.
Cross the maintenance room and its floor grate if your tunnel dead-ends.
Sprint to the surface exit and commit, because the guard tracks your noise trail.

modules.name: Dig to Escape Gameplay Guide
modules.description: See how the core systems fit together: digging routes, loot and selling, Toilet Paper income, classes and the endings they unlock.

highlights.label: Digging
highlights.detail: Break through cell floors and tunnel walls to open the physical route to every ending.

highlights.label: Loot
highlights.detail: Every block you clear can drop contraband and items worth carrying to the surface.

highlights.label: Selling
highlights.detail: Convert dug-up items into Toilet Paper, the currency that funds every escape.

highlights.label: Classes
highlights.detail: Pick one of five permanent classes to shape digging speed, stamina and detection.

highlights.label: Endings
highlights.detail: Trigger the Mineshaft, Kitchen, Janitor's or Rooftops finale once its gate is met.

modules.name: Dig to Escape Tools Guide
modules.description: Every digging tool and upgrade tier, from the free starter spoon to the Toy Shovel, Spatula and Golden Spoon, with the speed each one adds.

highlights.label: S
highlights.detail: Golden Spoon, the top early upgrade, with faster swings and far more durability.

highlights.label: A
highlights.detail: Spatula at 45 Toilet Paper, the mid-tier tool that keeps pace as layers harden.

highlights.label: B
highlights.detail: Toy Shovel at 25 Toilet Paper for +16 Digging Speed, enough to crack the second layer.

highlights.label: C
highlights.detail: Starter Spoon, free at spawn and only strong enough for the first layer.

modules.name: Dig to Escape Escape Tips
modules.description: Practical habits that shorten a run: recon the patrol, dig only in safe windows, bank your loot and match your class to the route.

highlights.label: Recon
highlights.detail: Watch one full guard pass before you break ground and plan around it.

highlights.label: Timing
highlights.detail: Never dig while you can hear footsteps, and never return to a fresh hole after a chase.

highlights.label: Banking
highlights.detail: Sell loot immediately so a failed escape costs you far less.

highlights.label: Classes
highlights.detail: Match your class to the route instead of buying on raw stats alone.

highlights.label: Routes
highlights.detail: Finish one ending before starting the next to avoid split progress.

faq.title: Dig to Escape FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers to the questions new players ask most about Dig to Escape.

items.question: What is Dig to Escape?
items.answer: Dig to Escape is a prison-break survival game where you start locked in a cell, dig through the floor and follow a rumored secret tunnel toward the surface while a guard patrols at night. It runs as a free Roblox experience and as a $12.99 VR release from K&K Studio for Meta Quest headsets.

items.question: How long does a Dig to Escape run take?
items.answer: A typical Dig to Escape session runs 30 to 60 minutes, split between scouting the cell block, digging toward the tunnel and timing your final break around the guard's patrol.

items.question: What is the fastest way to escape in Dig to Escape?
items.answer: Bank Toilet Paper early, buy a stronger shovel and dig straight down toward the rumored tunnel. The Mineshaft ending needs no purchases, the Kitchen ending needs about 300 Toilet Paper, and the Rooftops ending needs 300 Toilet Paper plus a 200 Toilet Paper Illegal Keycard.

items.question: Does Dig to Escape have codes?
items.answer: Dig to Escape has no redemption system, so no working codes exist. There is no codes button and no redeem field in the game, and any Dig to Escape code list claiming otherwise is fabricated.

items.question: Which class is best in Dig to Escape?
items.answer: Bargainer is the strongest Dig to Escape class for most players because it cuts every shop price by 20 percent, while Energizer and Hyperactive are the top picks for long, layer-heavy digs.

items.question: Can you play Dig to Escape with friends?
items.answer: The VR version of Dig to Escape is a single-user experience with no online co-op, local co-op or cross-play, while the Roblox version runs on shared public servers where other inmates dig alongside you.
